reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates longer, more targeted trail runs (13.4km and 8.8km) which are crucial for building the endurance and specific adaptations needed for trail racing. Plan B, while including a longer run (87 minutes), focuses heavily on aerobic endurance at a very easy pace, which is less effective for improving speed. Plan A’s inclusion of shorter, faster trail runs alongside longer runs provides a more balanced approach to developing both endurance and the ability to maintain a faster pace.
